name: shopify-refunds-and-returns-report
description: Use for "what's our store's return rate", "which products get returned most in the shop", "which size gets sent back", "how much are refunds costing the store", "are returned items going back on the shelf", "why are our Shopify refunds up", "refunds vs returns for our store", or "how much stock do we write off from returns" — even when the user never says "returns". Use when the decision is which products, variants or policies to fix because of what comes back, and whether returned goods are recovered or lost. Shopify only.
